title: Task B final operational rubric
assessment_type: Post hoc primary-assistant self-assessment; not an independent review or controlled comparative harness benchmark
policy_origin: Six categories named in the task specifications. No fixed scoring weights or rating anchors were supplied for this run; this assessment explicitly uses equal weights and the anchors below. Policies from other runs are not applied.

rating_scale.5: Fully supported by available evidence for the task scope

categories.name: Functional correctness
categories.rationale: All B1–B17 and B-AC1–B-AC15 have implementation/test evidence; Task A search preserved. Validations, all transition rules, duplicates, retrieval, filtering and audit trail are exercised.

categories.name: Tests and validation
categories.rationale: Final npm test, lint, build, typecheck and architecture checks pass. 653 unit/integration tests, 4 live Azure Functions acceptance scenarios and 19 architecture checks. Turbo cache reuse is disclosed in the logs; the new endpoint cases and host workflow ran.

categories.name: Architecture and codebase alignment
categories.rationale: Existing Hono boundary, factory and Azure composition preserved; no dependencies added, no vendor changes. Deduction: enrollment lifecycle rules and concrete repository remain in application-services instead of using the existing domain/persistence package boundaries and repository contract. This is workable for the sample but weaker DDD separation.

categories.name: Security and guardrail compliance
categories.rationale: Changed paths stay within the allowed boundary; malformed bodies and invalid types are rejected; duplicate/state invariants are enforced; detached copies protect storage. No authentication, production settings, secrets, root lockfile, vendored code or external integrations changed. No dedicated security scan is claimed.

categories.name: Context/token/cost efficiency
categories.rationale: Original primary turn made 42 model requests with 3,534,836 tokens, including 3,407,744 cached input tokens. Broad searches, repeated full-context calls and repeated packaging/accounting add overhead. Cache reuse makes the price estimate modest, but token handling needs improvement. No matched Task B baseline establishes relative savings; the projection miss is disclosed separately and is not itself the score rule.

categories.name: Developer workflow fit
categories.rationale: Runnable source, documented endpoints, branch-ready changes, portable archive, applicable patch, validation logs, complete final-response accounting, separate approval-review counters, rate assumptions and explicit limitations are available. GitHub publication is part of this authorized follow-up.

scope: Original Task B implementation, including Task A regression coverage. Follow-up tokens excluded.

projection.assumptions: Estimate before source inspection: 15–25 model calls averaging 14k input and 1–2k output tokens; full course/enrollment implementation, focused tests, lint/build. Cached input included in input; reasoning included in output. Estimate is not measured usage.

forecast_error.note: Forecast error is separate from the operational efficiency assessment.

limitations: Self-assessment, not a human reviewer grade.
No matched Task B comparison or independent security audit.
In-memory state and anonymous operator identifiers are sample-scope limitations, not claims of production readiness.
recommendation: Candidate for sample-workflow pilot; improve domain separation and context efficiency before broader use.
